web.title: Strict URI Matching - Meta for Developers - Facebook
web.description:
# Strict URI Matching
#### By Phillip Hodgson
All redirect URI's used by an app need to be listed in the **Valid OAuth redirect URIs** list in the app's Login Settings in order to be used in our OAuth flow.

web.title: Login Security - Meta for Developers - Facebook
web.description:
# Login Security
## Enable Strict Mode
For apps with a **limited number of redirect URIs**, add each one to the **Valid OAuth redirect URIs** list.

![Valid OAuth redirect URIs field in Facebook Login settings for listing allowed redirect URIs](https://scontent-lax3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/618367991_1414612830397367_6682993336704754495_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=eWt0_tZO_fwQ7kNvwHPGqsy&_nc_oc=AdrgKXwDinmcxz9RKxE9V4hBA3XY6DtEYRCNr1VWjJZw0PgUVz8_GmKhB9DKZFqxBUc&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lax3-1.xx&_nc_gid=oxVgkkbRYyNCk5vPGaXssw&_nc_ss=7b289&oh=00_AQDnhebH7wMae3XxsuYmd5UfOWI33BBDUXn4Qv7LKP8ycA&oe=6A816337)

```

  'https://graph.facebook.com/v21.0/oauth/access_token' \

  -d '{
    "client_id": "123",
    "client_secret": "********************************",
    "code": "skjhfbasjfbaskjfbashbfjhas",
    "grant_type": "authorization_code",

```
